historical_references.reference: Toufique is a Muslim name of Hindu origin. It is believed to have originated in Bengal, India, during the Mughal period when Muslims ruled over Hindu populations. The name may have been derived from the Hindu name 'Tuffah' which means 'deeply loved'. During the Mughal era, many Hindus converted to Islam, adopting Muslim names like Toufique.

Another theory suggests that the name Toufique is derived from the Persian word 'tufiq' which means 'helper' or 'supporter'. This theory originates from the period of the Delhi Sultanate, when Persian was the language of the ruling elite and influenced the naming practices of the population. Hindus might have adopted the name Toufique as a sign of loyalty to their Muslim rulers.
